name: humble-game
title: Buy Balatro from the Humble Store and save 15%

knownGaps.why: Genuine limitation, though a narrow one. The prices a shopper acts on span a single order of magnitude (CA$0.79 to CA$25.99) and share a shape. What breaks the page is two figures either side of them: a "-100% Store Discount" breakdown reading CA$0.01 to CA$0.00, and the prose line "the Humble community has contributed over US$282,000,000 to charity", which renders as 361,538 ZEC beside a 0.0179 ZEC game. Ten orders of magnitude, all of it genuinely on the page.

Genuine limitation. The CA$0.01 in the discount breakdown is 0.000009427 ZEC; the never-render-as-zero rule spends nine decimals on it, ten digits in all. Same open question as openai-pricing — whether a price this small should convert at all — arriving here from a store page rather than an API price list.
